chunks: Abū Baṣīr narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
I said: A man killed a woman.
He said: If the family of the woman wishes to kill him, they must pay half of his diyyah and then kill him; otherwise, they should accept the diyyah.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman’s family or legal heirs
key_terms.الدِّيَةَ: blood money paid as legal financial compensation
key_terms.نِصْفَ دِيَتِهِ: half of his blood money compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man kills a woman in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning retaliation when a man kills a woman. It states that if the woman’s family seeks qisas, they must first pay half of the man’s diyyah; otherwise, they may accept the diyyah instead.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5241 - Abu Baṣir narrated from one of the Imams (peace be upon them) that they said:
I asked: "What if a man kills a woman?"
Imam (as) replied: "If the family of the woman wishes to have him killed, they must pay half of his diyyah (blood money) and then they may kill him. Otherwise, they should accept the diyyah."
